checks.text: The page shows the heading "Virtual Piano" and the text "No notes recorded yet".
Clicking the key labelled "C4" adds a list item containing "C4" and the text "No notes recorded yet" is gone; the summary shows "Notes: 1".
After clicking "C4", then "E4", then "G4", the list shows three items in order: "C4", "E4", "G4", and the summary shows "Notes: 3".
Pressing the keyboard key "A" (mapped to note A4) adds a list item containing "A4"; the summary shows "Notes: 1".
Clicking the button "Clear notes" removes all list items, shows the text "No notes recorded yet", and the summary shows "Notes: 0".
Clicking the toggle button "Metronome" changes its label to "Metronome: On" and the text "BPM: 120" appears; clicking it again changes the label back to "Metronome" and "BPM: 120" disappears.
With the Metronome on, clicking the button "BPM +" changes the text from "BPM: 120" to "BPM: 124"; clicking "BPM −" changes it back to "BPM: 120".
Clicking the tab labelled "History" shows a table with a column header "Note" and a row containing "C4" after C4 has been played; clicking the tab labelled "Play" returns to the keyboard view.
Reload keeps the note list: after playing "C4" and "E4", reloading the page still shows list items containing "C4" and "E4" and the summary "Notes: 2".
